newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 3.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - March 3.

text.p: The Papua New Guinea government said on Sunday it wanted to buy RTZ Corp Plc-CRA Ltd's controlling stake in the giant Panguna copper mine as part of a solution to the seccessionist crisis on Bougainville. Also in London on Friday, RTZ's shares closed down 12.5 pence at 937.5 on negative press comments after their results.

Brambles Industries Ltd said on Friday that it was on track to achieve current market expectations for a full year net profit of about A$240 million. Brambles chief executive John Fletcher told Reuters in an interview that analysts should not extrapolate the stronger than expected first half profit growth into the full 1996/97 year.
Peter Lew, chief of the Witchery Fashion group and son of retailing baron Solomon Lew, has bought over nine percent of listed fashion retailer Country Road Ltd, it was revealed late on Friday.
Reef posted a first half operating loss of A$9.51 million late on Friday, saing that a slower than anticipated start to trading continued in the second half of 1996.
Arthur Yates posted a 6.9 percent lower net profit for the first half year of A$4.199 million.

Faulding is expected to post a half year net profit of about A$15 million. APN is expected to post a net profit of about A$27 million. HIH is expected to post a full year net of about A$60 million to A$65 million.
* The Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd A$0.046 (+0.001)

The Adelaide Steamship Co Ltd said on Sunday the planned float of its maritime operations could take place before June if market conditions were right. However, Adsteam chief operating officer David Ryan said the proposal would allow the float to be delayed as late as the first half of 1998 if necessary.
